name: pyope-performance-optimization
title: Optimize pyope performance
creator: lelouch
notes: Benchmark established on bc-beta-gamma nested NO simplification. OPEdefs remains faster, but phase-1 hot-path optimizations reduced pyope mean runtime from about 0.04197s to about 0.03136s.
